pricing_text: Billing is calculated per second of generated video, which matches the source video length. Video costs **$0.05** per second at **480p**, **$0.08** per second at **768p**, **$0.16** per second at **1080p**, and **$0.32** per second at **2K**. A **5-second** video at **768p** costs **$0.40**.
notes: usd = 480P (الأرخص)؛ الافتراضي 768P ($0.08/ث). المدة = مدة فيديو المصدر (حتى 15 ثانية).
